sections.heading: A good experience does not always become a public review
paragraphs: A client may thank their practitioner, book again and recommend your salon to friends. But someone choosing where to book their first appointment cannot see those conversations.

After a request to “leave a review”, the client still has to remember, search for the salon, find the correct address and open the form. Beauty Review Card Mini removes that manual search and makes the form available during the visit.

sections.heading: Not just at the till — wherever it is convenient for the client
paragraphs: In a nail studio, the main cards can sit at treatment stations. Clients can notice them during their appointment, and the practitioner can point out the card once the client has seen the result and can comfortably use their phone.

A card at reception creates another opportunity after the treatment. For a beauty salon or brow/lash studio, the principle is the same: choose a place where the client has seen the result and is not already rushing out.
We base the quantity on your space and how your team works. You do not automatically need a card at every chair or a large starter bundle.

sections.heading: How the client reaches the review form
paragraphs: A clear staff prompt and a short path for the client.
items: The practitioner or receptionist invites the client to share their experience.
The client taps the card with an NFC-compatible smartphone and opens the link offered by their phone.
The rating and review form opens for the correct Google business location. Google may ask the client to sign in.
The client chooses the rating, writes the text and decides whether to publish the review.

sections.heading: A short prompt for your practitioner or receptionist
paragraphs: “To share your experience, just tap your phone on the card.” No request for a particular rating and no pressure on the client.

sections.heading: Make your clients’ experiences visible to the next person
paragraphs: Before booking a first appointment, someone may look at your salon’s Google profile: its rating, the number and recency of reviews, and other clients’ experiences. Beauty Review Card Mini makes it easier to reach the review form.
Reviews may support local visibility alongside other factors. The card does not guarantee first place on Google, new bookings or a particular rating, and it is not a replacement for advertising.

sections.heading: A ready-made design you can see before ordering
paragraphs: The card keeps the design shown in the photos; we do not add your logo or change its colours. We set the NFC link to the review form for your Google business location. Choose Branded Mini for custom artwork.

sections.heading: What is included
paragraphs: Your order includes Mini cards in the pictured design, an NFC link to your Google business location, placement suggestions and a short staff prompt.

sections.heading: Choosing a quantity
paragraphs: In Ukraine, bundles of 1, 2, 4 and 10 cards cost 900, 1,440, 2,600 and 4,400 UAH per bundle respectively. Other quantities receive an individual quote.

sections.heading: How the card works
paragraphs: The card works with an NFC-compatible smartphone. The guest opens the link offered by their phone; Google may ask them to sign in. They choose the rating, text and whether to publish. The card does not guarantee reviews or search ranking.

sections.heading: Mini format
paragraphs: This is a physical NFC card in Mini format. We confirm its exact dimensions and thickness before ordering; specifications from the larger Branded Review Card do not carry over.

sections.heading: How to order
paragraphs: Choose a quantity and send an enquiry. We confirm the Google business location, price and lead time, then prepare cards in the pictured design. A 200 UAH deposit applies only to a confirmed physical order and is included in its price.

shared.home_restaurant_heading: Restaurant Review Card Mini / Branded Restaurant Review Card Mini
shared.home_restaurant_body: Use Restaurant Review Card Mini on a table or offer it with the bill. Choose the ready-made green card or Branded Restaurant Mini with your venue’s design.
shared.problem_addition: In a salon, a review request can get lost between the end of a treatment and the client leaving. In a restaurant, it can get lost between the waiter’s words and the guest taking action. These niche Review Cards make the form easy to open at that moment.
shared.how_addition: In a salon, the client uses the card at a treatment station or reception. In a restaurant, it is on the table or offered with the bill. The NFC journey is the same: compatible smartphone → offered link → the correct Google review form.
shared.facts_addition: Beauty and Restaurant Review Card Mini use a separate Mini physical format. Ready-made versions retain the pictured design; Branded Mini has approved custom artwork. We confirm exact size and thickness before ordering.
shared.included_addition: Every niche Mini card links to the correct Google location and comes with placement suggestions and a staff prompt. Branded Mini includes 3–4 free initial design concepts.
shared.process_addition: For ready-made Mini we confirm the Google location, quantity and terms. For Branded Mini we collect your logo, website or Instagram and style, show 3–4 initial concepts and approve final artwork before production.
shared.bulk_heading: Several cards for several useful points of contact
shared.bulk_body: Place cards at treatment stations and reception, or on tables and with the bill. Bundles of 1, 2, 4 and 10 have separate ready-made and Branded Mini prices; other quantities receive an individual quote.
shared.final_heading: Choose the action and use case for your business
shared.final_body: Choose Google reviews, Instagram or an online menu. Salons and restaurants can select a ready-made Mini card or Branded Mini with their own design.
shared.review_cross_heading: Looking for a use case designed for your sector?
shared.review_cross_body: Beauty and Restaurant Review Card Mini each come in two versions: a fixed ready-made design or Branded Mini with your business artwork. Each has placement ideas and a staff prompt.
shared.branded_cross_body: Salons and restaurants have dedicated Branded Mini cards with custom design, as well as ready-made Mini cards. Compare artwork, pricing and use cases on their pages.
shared.menu_cross_heading: The menu at the start. A review after the experience.
shared.menu_cross_body: NFC Menu Card opens your online menu. Ready-made and Branded Restaurant Review Card Mini help guests reach your Google review form at the end of their visit, at the table or with the bill. These are different products and separate actions.
shared.instagram_cross_heading: For salons: Instagram and Google reviews, separately
shared.instagram_cross_body: NFC Instagram Card opens your salon’s profile. Ready-made and Branded Beauty Review Card Mini open the Google review form with a use case for treatment stations and reception. Choose the card for the action you wish to offer.
shared.review3d_cross_body: For a salon or restaurant, compare a ready-made Mini with Branded Mini in your design. Both are separate from the 3D product.
shared.about_addition: We prepare Mini cards for a specific salon or restaurant use case: treatment station or reception, table or bill. Choose a ready-made design or approve your own for Branded Mini.
shared.contact_intro: We can help you choose an NFC card for Google reviews, Instagram or an online menu. Salons and restaurants can choose ready-made Mini or Branded Mini; consultation is free.
shared.contact_prompt: For a salon or restaurant, select ready-made or Branded Mini so we can address the right use case and design.
shared.delivery_addition: Ready-made Beauty and Restaurant Review Card Mini retain their fixed designs; Branded Mini uses approved artwork. We agree on quantity, price, lead time and delivery before the deposit. The 200 UAH deposit is included in a confirmed physical order. Nova Poshta delivery in Ukraine is free.
shared.terms_addition: An enquiry or consultation is not payment or automatic order confirmation. For Branded Mini we prepare 3–4 initial concepts free of charge; final artwork, quantity, price, lead time and delivery are agreed before production.
shared.warranty_addition: Contact us through the site for help with NFC, defects or refunds. We agree on return terms for personalised Branded Mini cards and shipping costs before payment.
shared.privacy_addition: We store your chosen niche Mini product and whether it is ready-made or branded so we can respond to your enquiry. Consent to process an enquiry does not include marketing messages.
shared.footer_description: NFC cards for Google reviews, Instagram and online menus. Ready-made and branded Mini options for salons and restaurants.

global_faq.question: How does the card work?
global_faq.answer: The client taps with an NFC-compatible smartphone and opens the offered link to the review form for your Google business location. Google may ask them to sign in. They choose the rating and whether to publish.

global_faq.question: Can I change the design?
global_faq.answer: The ready-made Mini keeps the design shown in the photos. Choose Branded Mini for your logo and colours.

global_faq.question: How is the design agreed?
global_faq.answer: Send your logo, website or Instagram and style preferences. We prepare 3–4 initial concepts free of charge; you choose a direction, request necessary edits and approve final artwork before production.

global_faq.question: How many cards can I order?
global_faq.answer: Fixed bundles are 1, 2, 4 and 10 cards. Other quantities receive an individual quote.

global_faq.question: When is a deposit due?
global_faq.answer: Only after a physical order is agreed. A 200 UAH deposit is paid once and included in the total.
